steps.description: === BLOQUE 2: SETUP - crear dos rutinas para poder reasignar ===

steps.script: window.__probeRoutineA = 'RutA PRB' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100); sessionStorage.setItem('__probeRoutineA', window.__probeRoutineA); const el = document.querySelector('#rt-name'); el.value = window.__probeRoutineA; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); console.error('PROBE_RUTINA_A: ' + window.__probeRoutineA)

window.__probeRoutineB = 'RutB PRB' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100); sessionStorage.setItem('__probeRoutineB', window.__probeRoutineB); const el = document.querySelector('#rt-name'); el.value = window.__probeRoutineB; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); console.error('PROBE_RUTINA_B: ' + window.__probeRoutineB)
console.error('PROBE_INICIO: bloque abrir ficha de vehiculo')

const card = document.querySelector('#maintenance-vehicles a[href^="/maintenance/vehicle/"]'); if (!card) throw new Error('No hay vehiculos en la flota'); sessionStorage.setItem('__probeVehicleUrl', card.getAttribute('href')); card.click(); console.error('PROBE_ABRIR_FICHA: ok')

window.__probeRoutineA = window.__probeRoutineA || sessionStorage.getItem('__probeRoutineA'); const select = document.querySelector('#ma-routine'); const option = [...select.options].find(o => o.textContent.trim() === window.__probeRoutineA); if (!option) throw new Error('Rutina A no esta en el combo'); select.value = option.value; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); console.error('PROBE_SELECCION_RUTINA_A: ' + option.value)
console.error('PROBE_INICIO: bloque reasignar a rutina B')

window.__probeRoutineB = window.__probeRoutineB || sessionStorage.getItem('__probeRoutineB'); const select = document.querySelector('#ma-routine'); const option = [...select.options].find(o => o.textContent.trim() === window.__probeRoutineB); if (!option) throw new Error('Rutina B no esta en el combo'); select.value = option.value; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true}))
const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Historial de rutinas'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Tab historial no encontrado'); btn.click()

window.__probeRoutineA = window.__probeRoutineA || sessionStorage.getItem('__probeRoutineA'); window.__probeRoutineB = window.__probeRoutineB || sessionStorage.getItem('__probeRoutineB'); const text = document.querySelector('#vehicle-maintenance-body').textContent; console.error('PROBE_HISTORIAL_MUESTRA_AMBAS: ' + (text.includes(window.__probeRoutineA) && text.includes(window.__probeRoutineB)))
steps.description: El historial debe mostrar la transición RutinaA -> RutinaB (RoutineAssignmentHistory)
